Marketing.body: Lan Pya turns one career goal into a clear next step, real work, trusted feedback, and an opportunity you can act on.
Marketing.climbAlt: Two students climb a night trail past three flags, choose, build and prove, and reach the summit as the sun rises.
Marketing.chooseTitle: Everyone has advice. Start from where you are.
Marketing.chooseBody: Answer a few honest questions and get one path that fits you now. Not ten opinions, not a course catalogue.
Marketing.buildTitle: Do one real piece of work.
Marketing.buildBody: A mission is a brief, a build and a submission. Something a person can open and inspect, not a video you watched.
Marketing.proveBody: A reviewer reads your work against a written method. What passes becomes proof, linked back to the work itself.
Marketing.summitTitle: Now you have something to show.
Marketing.summitBody: Open it in an interview. Attach it to an application. Every claim leads straight back to the work behind it.
